blocks.html: Once a GRG capture is built, this is where you label it, restyle it and add the markings your team needs before you share it.

slides.title: Open the GRG edit screen
slides.html:
After processing, the GRG Capture edit screen opens.

  • The check boxes on the right turn each feature on or off; tapping a feature's name opens its editor.
  • Drag the info box or point list to reposition them.

slides.title: Restyle the grid
slides.html:
Tap Edit Grid to set Label Style (MGRS, Letter/Number or Both), grid Color and Spacing.

  • Toggle Show Labels and Additional Labels for multi-page exports.

slides.title: Manage the point list
slides.html:
Tap Point List to set Text Color and Text Align.

  • Use the eye icon on each point to show or hide it on the capture; the radio buttons move the list's position.

slides.title: Set the crosshair
slides.html: Tap Crosshair to change its Color, brightness and Size. Keep it readable against your imagery.

slides.title: Edit the info box
slides.html:
Tap Info Box to set Title, Location, Date and Classification, plus Style (Box or Banner) and Text Align.

  • Each entry's text color can be set on the right.

slides.title: Add a compass
slides.html:
Tick the Compass box to show it, then tap Compass to pick Style (True + Mag or Full) and Color.

  • Use Left or Right to set its side of the grid.

slides.title: Add a scale bar
slides.html: Tick the scale bar box, then tap Scale Bar to set Style (Map Range or Cell Range), Unit, Size and Segment every. Tap Save on the edit screen to keep your changes.
